predictions.articleTitle: Non League Premier - Southern Central Matchday Intelligence: Stratford Town vs Banbury United Preview — Tactical Blueprint & Projections
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Stratford Town to win or draw (Home Win / Draw), anchored by a 2:1 primary scoreline and a 1:1 secondary stalemate.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw — Stratford Town lead on points per game and goal expectancy (1.59 vs 1.41), while their 7 draws in 16 league matches warrant draw coverage (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals — Supported by a 3.00 combined lambda, a 60.2% BTTS rate, and both defenses conceding over 1.65 goals per match (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)
2 or 3 Total Goals — Co-leading exact goal counts in the Poisson distribution at 22.4% each, covering both the 2:1 and 1:1 scripts (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Stratford's 1.59 goal expectancy meets Banbury's 1.81 goals conceded per game.

spf.comment: Stratford Town hold the stronger attack (1.38 goals/game) and a 1.59 vs 1.41 lambda edge for a 2:1 win script, but their 7 draws in 16 league games and 1.69 goals conceded per game make a single call weaker than pairing it with the 1:1 draw.

over_under.comment: Combined statistical goal expectancy reaches 3.00 (57.7% Over 2.5 probability and 60.2% BTTS) as two defenses allowing 1.69 and 1.81 goals per game face off.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Stratford's home scoring edge against Banbury's leaky backline, while 1:1 is the top Poisson scoreline (11.2%) and covers Stratford's 43.8% draw rate.

goals.comment: 3 goals and 2 goals co-lead the Poisson distribution at 22.4% each, aligning directly with the 2:1 and 1:1 projected scorelines.

bqc.comment: A tight opening half is expected before Stratford exploit Banbury's second-half defensive fatigue (Draw-Win) or settle for another stalemate (Draw-Draw).
